result.title: MuViRL: Multimodal View-Invariant Visual Speech Representation Learning via Calibrated View Aggregation
result.summary: Multimodal representation learning combines complementary signals to capture shared semantic information. For dynamic scenes, these representations need to remain consistent across views while preserving distinctions between temporal states. In visual speech representation learning, view variation changes the visibility and reliability of articulation cues, making it difficult to learn such representations from synchronized audio and video. To address this challenge, we propose MuViRL, a self-supervised framework for multimodal view-invariant visual speech representation learning via calibrated view aggregation. The framework combines synchronized 3D Gaussian view synthesis with multimodal self-supervision to learn consistent representations from real and synthesized data. A multimodal decision model learns relative view utility from teacher prediction losses, and its calibrated scores guide the aggregation of complementary information. Aggregation-to-Single Distillation transfers the aggregated predictions to a single branch. Real-synthetic alignment matches synchronized windows across views while preserving their temporal relations. Experiments on real and synthesized multiview data demonstrate that MuViRL improves multimodal representation consistency and visual speech recognition performance across views.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MuViRL 自监督框架，结合 3D Gaussian 视角合成与多模态自监督，用教师损失学习各视角相对效用的校准分数来加权聚合互补信息，并通过「聚合到单分支」蒸馏与真实—合成对齐获得跨视角一致的视觉语音表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按可靠性学习视角效用并加权聚合的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配问题相关，蒸馏将聚合结果压入单分支也可供核查多源证据如何并入单一推理状态，但原文目标是跨视角表示一致性而非 latent 推理。
